top_concerns: Chance-correction relies on unvalidated assumptions (uniform guessing, pre/post independence) and the worked example (80%->70%, k=4 gives ~6%) does not match the formulas
No noise-floor controls or confidence intervals: single sampled generations at T=0.6 create spurious flips; low/moderate/high labels undefined
Forgetting and backward transfer are confounded by prompting/format (few-shot base vs chat post-trained) and answer-extraction failures the authors themselves document
Uncontrolled public checkpoints cannot support causal claims about data scale, model scale or stage; high-data regime is admittedly inconclusive
MCQ-only probes and thin merging experiments over-reach relative to the claim that post-training does not erode pretrained knowledge
